summary: Tested the 3 new features and the iteration-71 regressions, backend (pytest) and UI (Playwright). (A) Prima nota: each registration is one summary row (n./data, causale·descrizione·party, 'N righe', dare/avere totals, actions). reg-toggle expands and collapses its rows (3 of 3). giornale-espandi-tutto expands all 89 rows, then collapses them, and its label changes. In print media all 89 detail rows are visible. The tfoot totals match (4055,50 = 4055,50). Edit opens the dialog; the lock button shows the motivo toast. (B) Ri.Ba. insoluti in blocco: GET /scaduti lists only 'maturato' effects, sorted by scadenza descending. POST /insoluti works: operatore gets 403; empty list gets 422; a future date or a date before the distinta gives an error per effect; in a mixed batch 3 are registered, and the errors for a 'presentato' effect and an unknown id do not block the others. Each registered effect becomes insoluto with nuova_scadenza = data + giorni. A RI prima nota entry is created that balances 129,50 (spese banca 30.07.011, recupero spese 20.05.001). The rata reopens in /scadenzario with the new due date and full residuo, and spese_cliente creates a partita. Registering the same effect again gives an error. In the UI: the dal filter works, select-all and uncheck update the count and total, the confirm dialog appears, the toast reads '2 insoluti registrati · nuova scadenza 03/12/2026', rows refresh, and the error toast for a future date shows the document number. (C) Bilancio contrapposte: Attività 846,50 = Passività 154,00 + Utile 692,50; Costi 18,50 + Utile 692,50 = Ricavi 711,00. The Dettaglio level 1 shows only the mastri. Clicking a row opens SchedaConto. Both print buttons switch the view and call print, and the print layout is fine. Regressions: (1) importing an IBAN for a legacy supplier keeps the old IBAN. (2) An invalid XML IBAN is stored as ''. (3) IbanCell: an invalid stored IBAN shows an input with a warning; valid banks show a select with 'Altro IBAN…', which reveals the input; saving replaces the invalid bank. (4) The liquidazione PDF has no '-0,00'; an invalid periodo returns the string detail 'Periodo non valido'. FOUND AND FIXED a CRITICAL regression: POST /api/pagamenti-fornitori/distinte returned 500 KeyError 'valido' whenever a new IBAN had to be saved to the supplier. The 'Altro IBAN' and invalid-IBAN flows were completely broken.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: the new bank was appended without the 'valido' key, and the next list comprehension used b['valido'], so it raised KeyError and returned 500 every time a new or corrected IBAN was sent. Added "valido": True to the appended dict (the IBAN is already validated at line 274). Retested: iteration71 19/19 pass, and the UI flow saved the IBAN.

minor.issue: HIGH impact on data: insoluto() calls matura(cid, body.data) BEFORE it validates that the date is not in the future. A rejected request with a future date (e.g. 2026-12-20) still turns 'presentato' effects due up to that date into 'maturato' and creates RS prima nota entries dated in the future. Reproduced: effect 4/2026 due 13/12/2026 became maturato with an RS entry dated 13/12/2026, and it showed up in the Insoluti in blocco list. Fix: matura(cid, min(body.data, _today())) or validate the dates first.

data='2025-02-30' passes the regex and then date.fromisoformat raises ValueError, which returns 500. Validate it with a field_validator or catch it and return 422. The same pattern probably affects other DATE_RX-only fields.
Only HTTPException is caught per effect; any other exception (e.g. in coge) aborts the batch after some effects were already registered, with no report. Consider catching Exception per effect.

ui_bugs.issue: step='0.01' is applied to every field, including the 'giorni' number input. Entering 1.5 days gives a 422 from the backend (int). Use step=1 for giorni.

issues: The summary row repeats the party: 'Fattura n. 1/2026 a TEST_T72 Cliente A Srl · TEST_T72 Cliente A Srl' (the description already contains the name)
In print both the summary row totals and the detail dare/avere are printed, so each amount appears twice in the Libro giornale. Consider leaving the summary amounts blank in print
On mobile (390px) the table needs horizontal scroll and the causale column wraps a lot (acceptable)
Date filters use the native browser date picker (pre-existing)
Accounts of tipo 'chiusura' are excluded from both prospetti. After closing entries the sides may no longer match; consider a note

action_items: riba.py insoluto(): do not call matura() with a future date (use min(body.data, today) or validate first), and clean up any premature RS entries
riba.py: return 422 instead of 500 for impossible calendar dates (e.g. 2025-02-30) in InsolutiBloccoIn / InsolutoIn
Review the tester fix in pagamenti_fornitori.py _crea ('valido': True on the appended bank)
Optional: catch generic exceptions per effect in /riba/insoluti; use step=1 for blocco-giorni; avoid the duplicated party name in the Prima nota summary
critical_code_review_comments: pagamenti_fornitori._crea had a KeyError regression with no test coverage until iteration71 was rerun; run the iteration71 suite after any change to _banche_party
importazione.conferma line ~317: update_one({'id': cur['id']}) has no company_id filter (cur comes from a company-filtered query, so it is safe but inconsistent)
BilancioContrapposto: the totals use the backend sums of the leaves while the rows are filtered by level; this is consistent, but rows with |saldo| < 0.005 are hidden

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_T72 and TEST_T71 companies, users and sessions (mongosh), clients, invoices and distinte. All were deleted with the test clean() functions; the DB has 0 companies, as before.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_iteration72_riba_insoluti_blocco_bilancio.py -n 0 (T72_KEEP=1 T72_RUN=123456 keeps the data; then python tests/ui_setup_t72.py adds 3 fresh maturato effects for UI; clean with `python tests/test_iteration72_riba_insoluti_blocco_bilancio.py clean`). UI login: cookie session_token=test_session_t72_admin plus localStorage fe_company_id. Invoice dates must be >= the previous invoice date (numbering lock). After the matura fix, add a test: POST /riba/insoluti with a future date must not change a 'presentato' effect.
rca of the issue: 1) KeyError 'valido': _banche_party now adds 'valido' to each bank; _crea appends the new IBAN dict without it and then filters on b['valido']. 2) Premature maturation: insoluto() runs matura(cid, body.data) to mature effects up to the insoluto date, before it checks body.data > today. A future date therefore matures effects that are not yet due and writes RS entries. Reproduce: an effect due in 30 days, POST /riba/insoluti with data=today+40; it returns an error, but the effect is now 'maturato'.
